study type: descriptive study, convergent mixed methods design
cohort: The study included 112 women with low ratings of overall childbirth experience, who were participating in a randomised controlled trial.
finding: The negative childbirth experience was dominated by fear-based emotions, with only small differences found when stratifying sub-themes on mode of birth and events during labour.
mod_finding: Only small differences in the sub-themes of negative childbirth experience were found when stratified by mode of birth.
